phase_0.boundary_condition: the emission envelope that seals the four verdicts into a single output
phase_0.domain_name: four independent runs all re-emitted → all verdict T

AFWD.justification: each run advances the buffer by appending a T verdict

AREV.justification: reverse morphism available but never invoked because every run succeeds

CLINK.justification: each AFWD composes after the previous to extend the buffer

ENGAGR.justification: available if a run produced both T and F but no run does

EVALF.justification: negative arm exists in structure but receives no runs

EVALT.justification: each run constructively proves its result as T

FFUSE.justification: would fuse T and non-T into a single state but non-T arm is empty

FSPLIT.justification: would split into T and non-T arms but non-T arm is never taken

IFIX.justification: each T is permanently fixed in the buffer and cannot be undone

IMSCRIB.justification: each emitted T is identical to itself and requires no transformation

TANCH.justification: contains all four verdicts and closes the system

VINIT.justification: no runs have executed and no verdicts exist yet

phase_2.fuse_result: single emission state containing only T verdicts
phase_2.rejoin_note: fork stays open in structure but only T arm receives runs; non-T arm remains empty so fuse would rejoin to T-only state
phase_2.verdict_reason: No fork/fuse — void, never weighed alternatives

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: available if a run contradicted itself but none do
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted: verdict non-T arm exists but receives no runs
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven: each run emits a verified T verdict
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: empty emission buffer before any run executes
